violation_type.title: Doors to Restroom -Unlocking Mechanism Accessible to Employees (26 TAC §747.4211(2)(A))
violation_type.short_title: Doors to Restroom -Unlocking Mechanism Accessible to Employees
violation_type.typical_finding: The restroom door inside the main daycare area is unable to be open if locked from the inside.

finding_variants.text: The restroom door inside the main daycare area is unable to be open if locked from the inside.

Primary Caregiver was not able to demonstrate how to unlock the bathroom door when it is locked from the inside in a satisfactorily manner.    This was corrected at inspection when the primary caregiver was able to find a tool to use when unlocking the bathroom door.
